<plan>The player starts at a table 1 step east of the current position, with a tree 2 steps east and grass to the west. No items are in inventory. The goal is to trigger all 22 achievements, which generally requires: placing a table, collecting wood (tree), collecting sampling (some object), collecting drink (water), crafting wood pickaxe and wood sword, placing a plant, defeating a zombie, collecting stone and placing it, eating a cow, eating a plant, defeating a skeleton, crafting stone pickaxe and stone sword, waking up after sleep, placing a furnace, collecting coal, iron, diamond, and finally crafting iron pickaxe and iron sword. A practical high‑level plan is:

1. Place a table in front of the player (this will count “Place Table”).
2. Move east until standing on the tree; do the “Do” action to collect wood.
3. Use the collected wood and the table to craft a wood pickaxe with “Make Wood Pickaxe”.
4. Use the player’s position next to the tree and the wood pickaxe to mine any nearby stone (if present); otherwise travel further to find a stone. Collect stone with the pickaxe.
5. Use the wood pickaxe and any available wood to craft a wood sword: “Make Wood Sword”.
6. Place a plant on any adjacent grass square with “Place Plant”.
7. Move to a cow (not currently visible; requires exploration) and eat it with “Do” to trigger “Eat Cow”.
8. Find a source of water (lake or well) and drink with “Do” to trigger “Collect Drink”.
9. Find and defeat a zombie; use the wood sword or pickaxe to kill it and trigger “Defeat Zombie”.
10. Place a stone block made with the pickaxe on an adjacent square with “Place Stone”.
11. Find and defeat a skeleton; again use the sword or pickaxe to kill it and trigger “Defeat Skeleton”.
12. Locate a furnace (or craft it by placing a furnace with “Place Furnace”) and use the furnace, wood pickaxe, coal, and iron to craft a stone pickaxe: “Make Stone Pickaxe”.
13. Use the stone pickaxe to craft a stone sword: “Make Stone Sword”.
14. Find coal and iron sources; mine them with the stone pickaxe to trigger “Collect Coal” and “Collect Iron”.
15. Return to the furnace to craft an iron pickaxe: “Make Iron Pickaxe”.
16. Use the iron pickaxe to mine a diamond if available; trigger “Collect Diamond”.
17. Use iron pickaxe and iron to craft an iron sword: “Make Iron Sword”.
18. If energy is low, sleep with “Sleep” and wake up to trigger “Wake Up”.
19. Eat any remaining edible plant to trigger “Eat Plant”.
Throughout the exploration, also collect any object required for “Collect Sampling” (this could be a special resource or item that is not described here; simply the first “Do” on a sampling source will trigger it).

This plan ensures all actions required for each achievement are accounted for. The first concrete action we can take right now is to place a table in front of the player.
